content_text:
Manhattan Active SCALE Documentation
        How to: Perform a DELETE Service Call from Metadata Action
    
    
         
                Collapse All
                Expand All
            
        View with Navigation Tools
    
    
User Interface Extensibility
 > Metadata Web Pages
 > Actions
 > How to: Perform a DELETE Service Call from Metadata Action
    
    
    
        Follow the steps below to make an action call a simple DELETE service.




     Step 1: Create a new web service



    If a new web service call is required, create it. Reference the various web service sections of the SDK for more information.





     Step 2: Create a screen control or find an existing screen control



    Please reference the How to: Create Screen Controls topic for instructions.



     Step 3: Create the screen control event and parameters for the action to perform a DELETE request



           

    Create a new SCREEN_CONTROL_EVENT record as follows. This defines what gets called when the event is fired. Insight Architect can also be used for this (How to: Use Insight Architect to Customize a Metadata Page).

    
        
            
                Field

                Value
            

            
                SCREEN_CONTROL_ID

                The Screen Control Id of the the control that fires the action
            

            
                EVENT_ID

                click or another event to be fired depending on the type of the control
            

            
                EVENT_NAME

                _webUi.insightListPaneActions.menuActionPerformDelete
            
        
    

    

    Now create a SCREEN_CONTROL_EVENT_PARAMETERS record to define the URL that will be called. Insight Architect can also be used for this (How to: Use Insight Architect to Customize a Metadata Page).

    
        
            
                Field

                Value
            

            
                PARAMETER_NAME

                DELETEServiceURL
            

            
                PARAMETER_VALUE

                The URL for web service minus query string parameters (i.e. /general/scaleapi/workInstructionsApi/removeHoldCode?)
            

            
                SCREEN_CONTROL_ID_EVENT_ID

                The Object Id of the screen control event
            
        
    

    

    Now create SCREEN_CONTROL_EVENT_PARAMETERS records to define the parameters that will be passed to the DELETE service call. Please reference the How to: Retrieve Parameter Values from the Insight Grid, How to: Retrieve Parameter Values from the Insight Detail Pane Model, How to: Retrieve Parameter Values from an Input Control, and How to: Retrieve Parameter Values from a JavaScript Function Call topics for more information on creating these records.

            
            See Also
Screen Control Event Parameter Naming Conventions

Follow the steps below to make an action call a simple DELETE service.








     Step 1: Create a new web service





    If a new web service call is required, create it. Reference the various web service sections of the SDK for more information.









     Step 2: Create a screen control or find an existing screen control





    Please reference the How to: Create Screen Controls topic for instructions.





     Step 3: Create the screen control event and parameters for the action to perform a DELETE request





           

    
Create a new SCREEN_CONTROL_EVENT record as follows. This defines what gets called when the event is fired. Insight Architect can also be used for this (How to: Use Insight Architect to Customize a Metadata Page).


    

        

            

                
Field


                
Value

            


            

                
SCREEN_CONTROL_ID


                
The Screen Control Id of the the control that fires the action

            


            

                
EVENT_ID


                
click or another event to be fired depending on the type of the control

            


            

                
EVENT_NAME


                
_webUi.insightListPaneActions.menuActionPerformDelete

            

        

    


    





    
Now create a SCREEN_CONTROL_EVENT_PARAMETERS record to define the URL that will be called. Insight Architect can also be used for this (How to: Use Insight Architect to Customize a Metadata Page).


    

        

            

                
Field


                
Value

            


            

                
PARAMETER_NAME


                
DELETEServiceURL

            


            

                
PARAMETER_VALUE


                
The URL for web service minus query string parameters (i.e. /general/scaleapi/workInstructionsApi/removeHoldCode?)

            


            

                
SCREEN_CONTROL_ID_EVENT_ID


                
The Object Id of the screen control event

            

        

    


    





    
Now create SCREEN_CONTROL_EVENT_PARAMETERS records to define the parameters that will be passed to the DELETE service call. Please reference the How to: Retrieve Parameter Values from the Insight Grid, How to: Retrieve Parameter Values from the Insight Detail Pane Model, How to: Retrieve Parameter Values from an Input Control, and How to: Retrieve Parameter Values from a JavaScript Function Call topics for more information on creating these records.
